# Daily Briefing — Thursday 19 November

Yesterday was a quiet one — no training, just 5,069 steps and 2,373 kcal burned, which neatly covers your daily target. That's fine occasionally, but with Chester 187 days out, momentum matters.

Recovery looks genuinely solid. HRV at 92ms sits right in your baseline range, resting HR a healthy 53bpm, and stress only 36/100. Your body is rested and ready — there's no physiological reason to hold back today. Go as planned and trust those numbers.

That 5.8 hours of sleep is the one flag worth addressing. Even with good HRV, chronic short sleep blunts fat metabolism and increases hunger hormones — tough when you're targeting 80-85kg. Prioritise getting to bed 45 minutes earlier tonight. Hit your 175g protein today to protect muscle, and you'll set tomorrow up well. You've got this! 💪
